nodes.description: AEMWE device performance comparison at 60°C in 0.05 M KOH.

nodes.description: Long-term industrial-relevant stability of AEMWE cell.
nodes.source_text: Our electrolyzer showed over 1000 h stability with no appreciable voltage increase (74.2 μV h^-1 / 1000 h degradation rate) at 60 °C.
